text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess delivered a splendid 
performance at the Victoria Mile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I wait for her return in the 
underground tunnel—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You had a great look on your face, 
Kawakami. Even during the race.
choice_data_list: That was such a her-like run, wasn't it?
That was just like her, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Well, of course. After all, I was the one 
who gave you that push!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hah!? That's how it's always been! What on 
earth were you looking at until now?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I always made sure to point out Kawakami's 
flaws, didn't I?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"As a senior! Because I debuted before you 
did, you know..."
choice_data_list: ...So you were worried about me, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Muuuugh! What's with that! You should be 
way, way more grateful to me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, shouldn't you say "thank you" first? 
And after that, you're treating me to some 
delicious juice!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! And... Sweep?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh♪ See ya, Kawakami! You'd better be 
grateful to me, too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My, Sweep-san was smiling even more than 
usual, wasn't she!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I suppose so. Today's race was 
truly—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —Because it was so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after the live concert finished, we 
returned to the academy, but...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, would you mind keeping me 
company for just a little while longer 
tonight?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It's nothing. It's just—...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Come on, follow right behind me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I head inside the school building, 
following Kawakami Princess who had dashed 
off in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! The stars are so beautiful~~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...The ground is quite far away, isn't 
it? Thinking about falling gives me the 
shivers."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Okaaay.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where I arrived was the rooftop. Checking 
the clock, it was almost time for the 
school building to be completely locked 
up.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer-san. The first three years 
are crucial for an Umamusume and her 
Trainer, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The first three years for an Umamusume 
and her Trainer. If, upon passing three 
years since debut, they haven't achieved a 
certain level of results—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They say that could also potentially 
become the moment an Umamusume and Trainer 
part ways.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...That won't happen to us, right?! After 
all, we've walked this path together up 
until now!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. Doing that disqualifies you from 
being a legendary Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Please don't just say 'sounds nice,' make 
sure to say 'that's right,' properly.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Don't just say 'nice', please give me a 
proper 'that's right.'"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—In my first Junior Class year. In order 
to turn me into a princess, you made 
getting used to racing our goal, rather 
than aiming for a GⅠ victory.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"The second year of the Classic Class. 
When I was lost in the dark, wondering 
what to do, you continued trying to guide 
me."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
To me, you are the best partner I could 
ever ask for— you brought out the absolute 
best in "me."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I want to keep running together with you.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...I'd prefer it if goodbyes remained far 
away."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I shall become your legendary 
princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Which means I'll have to rack up a ton of 
results over the remaining six months!"
choice_data_list:
For starters, how about we head to the 
Takarazuka Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, it is the Spring Grand Prix! The 
fiercest of all fierce battles to conclude 
the Spring GⅠ season!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Roger that, desu wa! I feel like that 
experience is essential on my path to 
becoming a princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Now then, I shall run completely wild!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Kawakami Princess and I set our 
new goal on the Takarazuka Kinen.
